decisions.what: Replaced existing dark-themed header with white/light header per spec 001
decisions.why: Spec explicitly defines header classes (bg-white/80, text-gray-900, border-gray-100) which differ from the existing dark header; spec must be followed exactly

decisions.what: Changed mobile menu from hidden/block dropdown to translate-x-full right-side sliding panel
decisions.why: Spec 001 requires fixed inset-y-0 right-0 w-64 with translate-x-full transition; app.js (spec 002) toggles translate-x-full class

decisions.what: Removed old mobile menu toggle IIFE from inline script when writing modified index.html
decisions.why: The old inline JS referenced hamburger-top/mid/bot IDs that no longer exist in the new header and toggled 'hidden' class instead of 'translate-x-full', which would throw errors and conflict with app.js

decisions.what: Combined task 001 and task 003 changes into a single index.html write
decisions.why: Both tasks modify index.html; task 003 only adds a script tag before closing body, so applying both changes together avoids a redundant write cycle while producing the correct final state

decisions.what: Nav links point to Home (#hero), Gallery (#gallery), Story (#story), Contact (#contact) as specified
decisions.why: Spec 001 explicitly lists Home, Gallery, Story, Contact as the four navigation destinations
